notes.title: How to play with your friends?
notes.content:
In the game you can use the keyboard + mouse. Only one player can do this. 
We recommend playing for four players with four gamepads.

2 ways:
1. Local in one screen! 
2. Online via Steam Remote Play Together! Just launch the game and press "Invite friend" on the skin selection screen. Learn more about Remote Play - https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay

Have a good Pre-Party, Chickenoidz!
